cases.name: Royal 'Coronation roles' - Kate's message, Louis' carriage ride and Meghan snub

sentences.1: The Coronation of King Charles will be the first time in 70 years that the UK or even the world has seen such a historic spectacle.
sentences.2: It is the first time in recent history that an already existing crown will be used during the Coronation of a Queen Consort instead of a new one being made.

Explanation.explanation: The argument relies on the tradition of using an existing crown during the Coronation of a Queen Consort instead of creating a new one as a basis for decision-making, without providing a strong rationale beyond tradition.
The statement presents the upcoming Coronation of King Charles as a historic event based on the time gap since the last similar spectacle, which may not inherently make it historic or significant.
